description: Denylist of decommissioned component names that must not appear in source comments. Add a term when a component is decommissioned — the moment an ADR, a CLAUDE.md rule, or a lesson note records the removal. Each entry is a case-sensitive Python regex matched against comment bodies only (never code or string literals). Consumed by scripts/validate-comments.py, severity error, ratcheted through scripts/comment-baseline.json like every other rule. See docs/shared/conventions/code-comments.md.

fields.id: Short stable identifier; appears in the violation message and therefore in baseline keys — renaming it invalidates baseline entries.
fields.pattern: Case-sensitive Python regex. Prefer word boundaries (\bName\b) over bare substrings.
fields.since: ISO date the component was decommissioned.
fields.replacement: What the comment should name instead.
fields.vault: Bare vault note basename for the See [[...]] pointer in the violation message.
fields.note: One line explaining why the term is stale, for whoever hits the violation.

terms.note: Jaeger was removed once OpenObserve stopped rejecting trace ingest; logs AND traces both go to OpenObserve and nothing listens on :16686.
